# hivelocity_service_types (Data Source)

Lists the service type codes used by `hivelocity_services`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "hivelocity_service_types" "all" {}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `service_types` (List of Object) Available service types. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--service_types))

<a id="nestedatt--service_types"></a>
### Nested Schema for `service_types`

Read-Only:

- `code` (String)
- `name` (String)
